description: CI affected target policy. Known-unstable project-level lint/test targets are explicit quarantine entries so PR gates can keep running strict targets without treating pre-existing monorepo debt as a new release blocker. Every entry is governed debt (ADR-0017): {owner, expiry, findingId, reason}. write-affected-target-report.mjs refuses to run on a malformed, expired, unknown-finding or RESOLVED-finding entry; the ceiling of each list only decreases.
